run_robot_free_space_test: run the robot free space hardware test script with a configurable number of random movement iterations
run_uniform_sample: run the uniform_sample function to generate random values between lower and upper tensor bounds
test_robot_move_to_ee_pose: test the RobotInterface move_to_ee_pose method by moving the robot to sampled random poses
test_robot_get_ee_pose: test the RobotInterface get_ee_pose method to retrieve the current end-effector position and orientation
test_robot_go_home: test the RobotInterface go_home method to return the robot to its home position
